mainEntity.name: What documents and information do I need to prepare for a home addition permit application?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a home addition permit application, you will typically need architectural drawings, site plans, structural engineering calculations, and energy efficiency documentation. You may also need soil reports or specialized plans depending on your project's complexity and local regulations. Gathering all required documents in advance, ensuring they are complete and accurate, is a critical preparation step that can significantly streamline the approval process and prevent delays. Hometelligent Inc. works with clients to compile the necessary paperwork for their specific city requirements.
